title: Missing default parameter in get_common_ancestor
detail: The call to get_common_ancestor does not provide a default parameter, which could raise a ValueError if there is no common ancestor.

title: Handling of special characters at the start
detail: If `spans` is empty, appending a span with a zero cell length might not correctly handle the start of the string.

title: Incorrect index increment
detail: The condition `index <= (codepoint_count - 1)` can lead to an infinite loop if `index` is incremented by 1 when it should be incremented by 2.

title: Incorrect handling of variation selectors
detail: The condition `if last_measured_character:` might not correctly handle variation selectors.
